extDesc.message: Sesha ngencazelo emakhasini owafundile. Konke kwenzeka endaweni — akukho nakancane okushiya idivayisi yakho.

searchPlaceholder.message: Chaza lokho okukhumbulayo… isb. “i-athikili ekhuluma ngamabhethri asebenzisa i-sodium”

statusSearching.message: Ngimba enkumbulweni… (usesho lokuqala lulayisha imodeli, ~imizuzwana engu-10-30)

statusEmpty.message: Akukho okuvelile. Kungenzeka awuzange ukufunde, noma i-Déjà ayikakukhumbuli.

optRetentionHelp.message: Amakhasi amadala asuswa ngokuzenzakalela kanye ngosuku.

optDenylistHelp.message: Iphethini eyodwa emugqeni ngamunye. Ifana nengxenye yekheli, isb. “example.com” noma “/private”.

optModelHostHelp.message: Akunalutho = huggingface.co. Setha iseva yakho yezindawo ezingaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi/zezinkampani.

omniboxDefault.message: Buza inkumbulo yakho — i-Déjà isesha ngencazelo

memoryEmpty.message: Inkumbulo ayinalutho — phequlula amakhasi ambalwa bese ubuya.

memoryImportConfirm.message: Buyisela engobweni yomlando? Amakhasi afanayo azobhalwa phezu kwawo.

welcomeIntro.message: Kusukela manje ngikhumbula lokho okufundayo, ukuze ukuthole kamuva ngencazelo — ngamagama akho, hhayi ngesihloko esiqondile.

welcomePoint1.message: Konke kwenzeka kudivayisi yakho. Awekho amaseva, alikho ifu, ayikho idatha ethunyelwayo — noma kuphi, noma nini.

welcomePoint2.message: Imeyili, izingxoxo, ukungena ngemvume kanye namabhange akukaze kukhunjulwe. Qaphela: angikwazi ukubona izihloko ezibucayi ngekheli — kuzo, sebenzisa ukumisa okwesikhashana noma uhlu lwakho ezilungiselelweni.

welcomePoint3.message: Nguwe ophethe: misa okwesikhashana ngokuchofoza kanye, “Sula inkumbulo” isusa konke, futhi uma uthanda ngikhohlwa ngokuzenzakalela ngemva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa.

panelNoPage.message: Vula ikhasi lewebhu futhi i-Déjà izokukhombisa lokho okufundile ngesihloko salo.

welcomePoint4.message: Iphaneli eseceleni ibona ikheli nesihloko sekhasi olibukayo ukuze ikhombise lokho okufundile ngesihloko salo — enkumbulweni yeseshini kuphela. Iziqephu ozigcina ngamabomu nazo zihlala kuwe kuphela.

welcomeUpdated.message: I-Déjà ibuyekeziwe. Okusha: uma uthanda, manje namabhukhimakhi akho angaseshwa ngencazelo. Nakhu engikwenzayo ngedatha yakho — akukho okushiye idivayisi yakho.

optAmbientHelp.message: Inethi yezinkumbulo ngemuva kwengilazi intanta kancane. Yivale uma ukunyakaza kukuphazamisa.

bmText.message: I-Déjà ifunda izihloko namafolda wamabhukhimakhi akho ngaphandle kokuvula amakhasi. Wathole ngencazelo kusukela emzuzwini wokuqala — konke kuhlala kudivayisi yakho.

bmTextShort.message: Inkumbulo yakho isencane. Ngifundise amabhukhimakhi akho bese uwasesha ngencazelo namuhla.

bmNote.message: Isiphequluli sakho sizocela imvume. Ungakuvala noma nini ezilungiselelweni.

bmPaused.message: I-Déjà imisiwe okwesikhashana — ngizoqhubeka nje lapho uqalisa kabusha.

bmError.message: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle ngesikhathi ngifunda. Ngizozama futhi ngoshintsho olulandelayo.

bmDone.message: Kuqediwe — amabhukhimakhi angu-$COUNT$ ayaseshwa ngencazelo futhi avumelaniswa ngokuzenzakalela.

bmDoneOne.message: Kuqediwe — ibhukhimakhi eli-1 liyaseshwa ngencazelo futhi livumelaniswa ngokuzenzakalela.

bmDenied.message: Ngaphandle kwemvume angikwazi ukubona amabhukhimakhi akho. Ungazama futhi noma nini.

optBookmarksHelp.message: Ngifunda izihloko namafolda wamabhukhimakhi akho (ngaphandle kokuvula amakhasi) futhi ngilandela njengoba uwengeza noma uwasusa. Ukukuvala kuwasusa enkumbulweni — amakhasi owafundile ayasala.

welcomePoint5.message: Amabhukhimakhi — kuphela uma ukuvula: lapho ngifunda izihloko namafolda awo, ngaphandle kokuvula amakhasi. Ukuchofoza kanye kuyakuvala.

rateTitle.message: I-Déjà ikusizile ukuthola okuthile — izikhathi ezingu-$COUNT$ manje

rateText.message: Uma iwusizo, isilinganiso esitolo sisiza abanye abantu ukuthi bayithole — kuthatha imizuzwana eyi-10. Futhi uma kukhona okukucasulayo, sitshele.

answerEnableTitle.message: Izimpendulo ezivela ku-AI eyakhelwe ngaphakathi ku-Chrome

answerEnableText.message: I-Déjà ingaphendula imibuzo isuka kulokho okufundile, inemithombo. I-Chrome ilanda imodeli yayo esebenza kudivayisi (Gemini Nano) kanye kuphela — imibuzo namakhasi akho akaze ashiye ikhompyutha yakho.

answerFoot.message: Ibhalwe kudivayisi yakho yi-AI eyakhelwe ngaphakathi ku-Chrome isuka ezinkumbulweni zakho ezingu-$COUNT$. Hlola imithombo.

optAnswersLabel.message: Izimpendulo ezivela ku-AI eyakhelwe ngaphakathi ku-Chrome

optAnswersHelp.message: Emibuzweni efana nethi “bengifundani nge…?” ngibhala impendulo emfushane enemithombo evela emakhasini akho — ngokuphelele kudivayisi yakho, nge-Gemini Nano ku-Chrome. Idinga ikhompyutha nolimi olusekelwayo (isiNgisi, isiSpeyini, isiJalimane, isiFulentshi, isiJapane).

optAnswersDownloadable.message: Iyasekelwa — i-Chrome izolanda imodeli embuzweni wakho wokuqala.

optAnswersUnavailable.message: Le divayisi noma ulimi lokusebenzisana akusekelwa yi-AI eyakhelwe ngaphakathi ku-Chrome.

optAnswersUnsupported.message: Lesi siphequluli asinayo i-AI eyakhelwe ngaphakathi — konke okunye ku-Déjà kusebenza njengenjwayelo.
